findings.highlight: A world that has continued without ending, changing, or evolving is finally coming to an end.
findings.evidenceJa: 果てず、翻らず、成らぬまま、連綿と続けられた一つの世界が、ここに終わろうとしている。
findings.governingReading: 成らぬまま follows the thousand-/five-hundred-year pursuits: the continued world/project has remained unfulfilled/unrealized.
findings.explanation: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.

findings.highlight: Only its obsession is still intact.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、その執念だけで、未だこの世に留まっていた。
findings.governingReading: Only through that obsession he still remains in this world.
findings.explanation: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.

findings.evidenceJa: 単に、彼らは脱落したのだ。
findings.governingReading: The family simply fell out of the running; next page states its lifespan as a mage lineage had reached its limit and was declining in Zouken's generation.
findings.explanation: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.

findings.highlight: Yes, I must not die. Damn this rotting body. It's painful, so painful. Too painful. Five hundred years of pain. My whole life has been pain. Why fault me for seeking eternity? I suffered and suffered, never fulfilled, so how can I disappear without leaving anything behind? How can I die in agony? The Holy Grail is open before me. So listen to my wish, ask and I shall answer. My wish is that I DON'T WANT TO DIE, I need to get there, my wish will come true if I climb that cliff, it'll grant my wish but I can't reach it with this body, it's so far away, these last five centuries have been for nothing, it's so far away, why oh why is it so far away—!?!?!?
findings.evidenceJa: そう、死ぬ訳にはいかない。崩れる体が恨めしい。苦しいのは苦しい。とにかく苦しい。苦しいだけの五百年だった。苦しいだけの人生だった。それ故に永遠を求めて何がわるい。苦しんだ苦しんだ、満たされないまま苦しんだ、何も残せぬまま消えるなど出来るものか、苦しいまま死ぬなど出来るものか、目の前には聖杯が開いている、ならば我が望みを聞くがいい、問われれば答えてやろう、我が望みはシニタクナイ、あそこまで、あの崖を登れば願いが叶う、願いが叶うというのにこの体ではたどり着けぬ、たったあれだけの距離、この五百年を顧みれば塵にも等しい、たったあれだけの距離が、なぜ、なぜこんなにも遠いのか—！！！！
findings.governingReading: The distance is merely that little, dust-like when compared with his five hundred years, yet impossibly far for this body.
findings.explanation: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.

findings.highlight: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.
findings.evidenceJa: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
findings.governingReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

findings.highlight: He knew he would suffer defeat and that he would not attain it in this body, but he never gave up as long as he lived.
findings.evidenceJa: 幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
findings.governingReading: Though repeatedly beaten down and repeatedly realizing this body cannot attain it, he could not give up while alive.
findings.explanation: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.

findings.highlight: Even when he remade himself, he never overcame the laments of his youth.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を覆したかった。
findings.governingReading: He wanted to overturn the immature grief seen in youth, even by remaking himself.
findings.explanation: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.

findings.highlight: Even if it lies beyond this life. Even if he isn't rewarded...
findings.evidenceJa: たとえその生に。何の報いが、なかったとしても。
findings.governingReading: Base 生 and ruby さき place no reward in that life/future: even if there were no recompense for him.
findings.explanation: No reward in his life/future becomes an ideal lying beyond this life.

findings.highlight: Wherever the Makiris' voyage ended would be their final resting place.
findings.evidenceJa: マキリの旅は、何処で果てようと、所詮はこんなところ止まりである。
findings.governingReading: Wherever the journey ends, the Makiri venture can after all reach only this sort of point/limit.
findings.explanation: Limited reach of the Makiri journey becomes tautological final resting place.

findings.highlight: Far too short a time to accomplish anything.
findings.evidenceJa: たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
findings.governingReading: How could they reach the desired destination with merely that span of years? Following lines specify distant maturation of humanity.
findings.explanation: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.

findings.highlight: One of the mages sought a miracle, an observer who was there at the very beginning, crumbles away.
findings.evidenceJa: 奇蹟を求めた魔術師たちの一角、生きながらえ当事者であり続けた傍観者が崩れていく。
findings.governingReading: One cornerstone among the miracle-seeking mages, a survivor who continued as participant while being an observer, crumbles.
findings.explanation: Missing relative clause and lost continuing participation.
